facts.text: Less than 5% of Garry oak ecosystems remain in near-natural condition; on Vancouver Island only 1.5% of the original deep-soil sites remain.
More than 100 plants and animals of Garry oak ecosystems are officially listed as species at risk.
Arbutus is the only broad-leaved evergreen tree species in British Columbia.
